decisions.reason: memory_fast has much lower leave-trajectory-out error than the current state model and delay; alternating inputs can help distinguish accumulated history from lagged response.
decisions.prediction: After rapid input switches, memory_fast predicts a smoother, history-dependent response than a pure delay model.

mapping.target_relation: The observations support adding predictive history features, but do not establish a specific cross-domain relation.
mapping.condition_to_check: Compare alternating-input forecasts with delay-model predictions and test whether accumulated history improves trajectory-level accuracy.

decisions.reason: memory_slow has substantially lower trajectory-level CV error than the current model; the alternating trajectory also shows persistent history-dependent response.
decisions.prediction: After the second pulse, the response will depend on the earlier pulse and decay more slowly than memory_fast predicts.

mapping.target_relation: The predictive benefit of slow history features does not establish a specific cross-domain relation.
mapping.condition_to_check: Test whether double-pulse forecasts improve and whether the post-pulse tail retains dependence on the first pulse.
